body:
Adds `research/smooth-twin` (builds on HIRO / CAIRO directions; no affiliation implied).

- Real reward has a hard edge, so its gradient is zero; a logistic-smoothed twin supplies the signal.
- Exact/verified results: overshoot law, trap threshold τ_c≈0.105, closed-form upper threshold τ_u=R/(8cm), annealing across the trap, smoothing as a capped safety margin under edge uncertainty.
- 11 tests, deterministic experiments (~6 s), white paper with references, README and site entry updated; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Stylised: one parameter, logistic smoother, deterministic ascent, simulated "real" plant.
